title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1902: Control kings lineage (3)

section.p: West Royal Consort laughed and asked, “Why would someone from my faction block Immortal Battle for you?”
“True.” Su Yu nodded, “That’s why I’m unsure. But that human used a very unique dao…”

Su Yu frowned and continued, “That dao was chaotic. When I try investigating, not even the immortals know the identity of that human. Is it possible that there is still a human at the level of a heavenly king up there? If I can recruit him, I can even use him to slow Hundred Battle down.”
West Royal Consort smiled and said, “Sure. You can try recruiting that human.”
“Shut your mouth!” Su Yu said furiously, “I’m worried that this human is also a traitor like you.”
West Royal Consort merely smiled without saying anything.

“Since you don’t know, forget that matter for now.” Su Yu exhaled and said, “One final matter. I managed to find the location of an entrance to the Upper Realm. I intend to send some people up there and scout around. The people of Stable Army Marquis informed me that we can meet at a place called Chaos Mountain. But Great Zhou King said that Chaos Mountain is filled with ancient beasts. It is a very dangerous place. I’m not sure if this is a ploy by Stable Army Marquis to kill me.”
Su Yu continued, “Even if I won’t be going myself, I’ll be sending a top expert. I’m worried that something bad will happen.”

His eyes turned frosty as he continued, “After due consideration, I have decided to call for a meeting between all human survivors up there. We will be meeting at Chaos Mountain. There, I intend to cause a beast wave and wipe them all out.”
West Royal Consort’s expression changed slightly.

Su Yu continued, “But for this, I require your help. You know a concealment formation. I am planning to send Great Qin King, but I don’t want him to die. Perhaps your formation can help protect him from the beasts there.”

West Royal Consort said, “Those ancient beasts can’t be influenced so easily. Do you think this is a new idea? Some had thought of this idea before, but for the most part, they ended up getting themselves killed.”

Su Yu sneered and said, “Do you take me for a fool? Of course I know the risk. But Great Qin King follows the dao of the heavenly desolate beast. Strictly speaking, he is also an ancient beast. According to what I know, those ancient beasts are capable of communicating with each other. Perhaps Great Qin King can trigger a beast wave due to the dao he follows. If not even that works…I still have the heavenly desolate beast corpse. I will hand him the corpse and have him detonate that corpse. Will that be enough to trigger a beast wave?”

West Royal Consort’s expression changed even more, but she quickly regained her calm. With a chuckle, she said, “You sure are crazy and ruthless. Are you actually thinking of killing those Upper Realm humans? You’re an even bigger traitor than those of my line. Su Yu, you keep insulting my line, but you seem worse than us.”

Su Yu said coldly, “One needs to be cruel to achieve great things. Since I don’t have their support, what’s the point of keeping them around? Also, I don’t need you to evaluate me. I only need your formation. Do you have any formation capable of hiding from those beasts?”
West Royal Consort sneered and said, “How is that possible? You think too much. Your plan won’t work.”

Su Yu asked with a frown, “Are you sure? When we fought, there was no leakage of aura. So be it. Just hand that formation of yours to me. I’ll have some people study it. No matter what, I’ll give it a try. You won’t lose anything, right? After all, your line wishes for the elimination of the human race as well. I’ll wipe out the Upper Realm humans for you.”
West Royal Consort said, “I won’t hand you the formation. Su Yu, that is a secret formation of my line. We don’t teach it to outsiders. Stop dreaming, Su Yu.”

Su Yu said, “It’s only a formation. And it is only capable of concealing auras. It isn’t even an offensive formation. Teach my people this formation and I’ll wipe out the Upper Realm humans for you. Isn’t this your aim? Or are you saying that your people are also among the Upper Realm humans? Are you trying to ensure their survival?”

West Royal Consort remained silent. In any case, she wouldn’t hand the formation out. She couldn’t. She was worried that Su Yu would really be crazy enough to trigger a beast wave at the Chaos Mountain after getting the formation.

Sure, he would most likely fail. But Su Yu had the corpse of the heavenly desolate beast. And Great Qin King had indeed fought using the heavenly desolate beast’s dao previously. And the heavenly desolate beast was an ancient beast as well.
Could the detonation of its corpse trigger a beast wave? Nobody could be sure. But if it succeeded, things would get troublesome.

Thus, West Royal Consort could only refuse to hand over the formation. Without the formation, Su Yu might not be willing to risk the lives of his close supporters like Great Qin King and Great Xia King, This was her way of preventing this from happening.

At her refusal, Su Yu grabbed her neck furiously and roared, “You fool! I’m wiping out the Upper Realm humans for you! Your line will only benefit from this! You won’t lose anything! It’s only a formation. Why are you refusing me?”
While coughing blood, West Royal Consort smiled and said, “I can’t. Our ancestral teachings do not allow us to teach outsiders the formation. This won’t change even if you kill me.”

“Damn it!” Su Yu looked livid. He snorted and said, “Do you think I will be helpless just because you refuse to hand me the formation? It’s not like there’s only one concealment formation in existence…”

With blood still dripping down her mouth, West Royal Consort grinned and said, “Stop being delusional. This won’t work. The dao of Chaos Mountain is different from the daos out here. The formations of Myriad Realms will most likely stop working there. You are someone with the Heaven Gate. You don’t understand this because you’re not in the Upper Realm. If you’re there personally, you will understand that all powers will be suppressed at the Chaos Mountain. Stop dreaming.

“You don’t even have that many Daofuses on your side. Losing Great Qin King and Great Xia King will only accelerate your death. It’s fine for you to die, but I’m not interested in dying with you. I advise you to give up on this foolish idea. Furthermore, wiping out the Upper Realms human will only worsen your situation when the Upper Realm opens. You won’t even have the chance to put up a struggle anymore.
“Since you have a way to send some people up there, you are better off thinking of a way to recruit those Upper Realm humans. Hundred Battle is still sealed, right? This is your opening.”
Su Yu frowned.

West Royal Consort smiled and said, “Su Yu, stop thinking about killing all the time. If I’m not here, I’ll be supportive of this plan as well. But now, I need you to survive. I don’t want to die because of you.”
Su Yu stared at her with a deep frown. After a long while, he sneered and said, “Are you trying to mislead me? It’s not going to work.”

At that, he vanished. West Royal Consort maintained her smile for a long while before exhaling in relief. Su Yu was truly a lunatic. He was actually thinking of triggering a beast wave at the Chaos Mountain. Could the corpse of a heavenly desolate beast really trigger something like that?
She was unsure. Her mood was heavy. Clearly, Su Yu was starting to target the Chaos Mountain. She could only hope that he would give up on that idea soon.
After leaving the book, the fury on Su Yu’s face vanished.

West Royal Consort was trying to prevent the beast wave from happening. She was unwilling to hand him a formation that could help even if it was for the purpose of wiping out the Upper Realm humans. Ancestral teachings preventing her from handing it over? Absolute nonsense.
“What was she worried about? Was she worried that the beast wave would trouble those from Control King’s lineage?

“In that case, Great Ming King might be right. That lineage might really be hiding somewhere deep inside the Chaos Mountain. She didn’t even look that surprised when I mentioned a random human expert capable of contending against Immortal Battle Marquis. That’s someone at the level of a heavenly king. Isn’t the appearance of such a human something shocking? Yet she seemed unbothered. She merely claimed to know nothing. She also denied that her lineage was the culprit behind Marquis Minshan’s death…”
Numerous thoughts emerged in Su Yu’s mind. After a short while, he reached a conclusion. Great Ming King was most likely correct.

This lineage was most likely hiding in the Chaos Mountain. And there were more experts at the level of heavenly kings among them. The so-called expert with black robes was merely a lie by Su Yu, but West Royal Consort had taken it seriously. Perhaps she believed that the mysterious human was probably someone on her side. Thus, she had refrained from saying anything.
“I really want to kill her and read her memories.”
His desire to kill her intensified. But he also knew that killing her would attract the suspicion of those from Control King’s lineage.
Great Ming King remained silent when he noted that Su Yu was in deep thought.
When Su Yu stopped, he asked, “How was it?”
Su Yu inhaled deeply and said, “You might be right. This lineage might really be hiding here. And they have a decent number of experts. There are definitely one or more heavenly kings among them.”

Great Ming King did not look surprised. After all, this was his own deduction. He said, “In that case, they are clearly trying to sweep in and snatch the final victory at the very end. The myriad races and humans have fought for so many years while they have been silently gathering strength. When both myriad races and humans are exhausted from all the fighting, they will appear and become the final victor. How ambitious of them.”

Su Yu stared at the depths of the mountain range for a long while before saying, “It doesn’t matter if we don’t know about them. But since we’re already aware of them, they can give up on this dream to fish in troubled water.

“They definitely lack the power to conquer the Myriad Realms or they wouldn’t have remained in hiding until now. They are still waiting. West Royal Consort’s collusion with West Heavenly King is proof that they still lack strength.” “Perhaps they are waiting for Hundred Battle King to return and exhaust even more of the myriad races’ strength. If that’s the case, we have more time to prepare.”
Great Ming King nodded, “True. But in that case, it will be much more dangerous for us to stay here.”
“I know.”
Su Yu nodded. But this was the outer region of the mountain range. Those people were probably hiding deep inside the mountain range to prevent detection. Thus, they wouldn’t notice anything so soon.
“Keep looking for the formation core. Put this matter aside for now. Also, don’t tell anyone about this.”
Great Ming King nodded. He did not protest as leaking what they knew might not benefit them.

As for the option of leaking this information to the myriad races, there was no guarantee that the myriad races would trust it. Even if they would somehow trust it, the leak would only be useful when it happened at the right time.
